name: Infinity Logistics and Transport Ventures Limited
summary: Infinity Logistics and Transport Ventures is an investment holding company set up in 2003 and based in Klang, Malaysia, a subsidiary of 2926 Holding. It offers logistics services in eight countries across Asia and Europe, including Malaysia, China, Singapore and the Netherlands. Its segments are integrated freight forwarding, logistics centre services such as warehousing and container depots, rail and road transport, flexitank solutions for bulk liquids, and fourth-party logistics.
